authorization: User confirmed the documented administrator preflight, bounded chronyd suspension, tick correction and conditional proxy rerun.
scope: Read-only WSL root PID namespace preflight; no signals or clock writes.
requested_stdin:
printf 'A2_ROOT_PREFLIGHT_BEGIN\n'
id
uname -r
printf 'ROOT_PID_NAMESPACE='
readlink /proc/1/ns/pid
printf 'SELF_PID_NAMESPACE='
readlink /proc/self/ns/pid
printf 'PID1_COMM='
cat /proc/1/comm
printf 'BOOT_ID='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'UPTIME='
cat /proc/uptime
printf 'TOOLS\n'
command -v python3 python busybox nsenter chroot chronyc chronyd || true
printf 'CHRONYD_PROCESSES\n'
for record in /proc/[0-9]*/comm; do
  IFS= read -r name < "$record" || continue
  case "$name" in
    chronyd)
      base=$(dirname "$record")
      printf 'PROCESS_BEGIN=%s\n' "$base"
      cat "$base/stat"
      sed -n '/^Name:/p;/^State:/p;/^Pid:/p;/^PPid:/p;/^NSpid:/p;/^NStgid:/p;/^Uid:/p' "$base/status"
      printf 'EXE='
      readlink "$base/exe"
      printf 'PID_NAMESPACE='
      readlink "$base/ns/pid"
      printf 'MOUNT_NAMESPACE='
      readlink "$base/ns/mnt"
      printf 'CMDLINE\n'
      tr '\000' '\n' < "$base/cmdline"
      printf 'PROCESS_END\n'
      ;;
  esac
done
printf 'A2_ROOT_PREFLIGHT_END\n'
exit
